fact_check.math: Re-computed: 99.99 - 79.99 = 20.00; 79.99 + 20 = 99.99; month 1 free so months 2-12 = 11 paid; 11 x 7.99 = 87.89; 99.99 + 87.89 = 187.88; 79.99 x 2 = 159.98 < 187.88, so 'more than double' is true. 'First twelve months' now correctly counts the free month. The v1 error is fixed.
fact_check.rule_a_b_c_d: All figures agree across say, text and on_screen ($79.99, $99.99, $20, $7.99, $87.89, $187.88). Badges 'LAUNCH DAY / +$20 UPGRADE', '11 MONTHS = $87.89', '12 MONTHS = $187.88' match the narration. Rule D ok (say 'GTA six'/'GTA plus', text 'GTA 6'/'GTA+').
residual_risks: The $7.99 GTA+ price rests on a 2024 TweakTown article; it is hedged with 'Reportedly' in speech and on screen, which is acceptable, but a 2026 primary source would remove the risk.
'No disc, just a download code' is a secondary report (tech-insider); hedged with 'Reportedly'. Acceptable.

The 12-month window assumes the free month starts at the same time as the paid clock; the sources do not state when the trial starts, so 'first twelve months' is an illustrative Benny-timeline figure, not a universal bill. It is framed as 'His total', which is fair.
Hook 'is a trap' is editorial but true as framing: the sticker price is only the start for Benny's choices.
